title: Reversible ON–OFF switching of single-molecule magnetism associated with single-crystal-to-single-crystal structural transformation of a decanuclear dysprosium phosphonate

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: oxalate-bridged decanuclear dysprosium(III) EDDC/9-anthrylmethylphosphonate cluster hexahydrate

material_class.structural_family: oxalate-bridged pair of cyclic Dy5 phosphonate pentamers

synthesis.procedure: H2EDDC (59.6 mg, 0.20 mmol) and triethylamine (0.07 mL, 0.5 mmol) were slurried in water/methanol (20 mL, 1:3). Solid Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (82.4 mg, 0.20 mmol) and sodium oxalate (20.1 mg, 0.15 mmol) were added at room temperature and the mixture was stirred for 24 h. C15H11PO3H2 (54.4 mg, 0.2 mmol) was then added and stirring continued for 24 h at room temperature. The mixture was sealed in 25 mL glassware and kept in a vacuum drying oven at 100 °C for 7 days, giving dark red single crystals as a single-phase product.
synthesis.time: 24 h + 24 h stirring, then 7 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed 25 mL glassware in a vacuum drying oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark red single crystals formed after 7 days at 100 °C as a single-phase product.

properties.summary: I is not an SMM: dc susceptibility is typical of weakly coupled Dy(III), and zero-field ac susceptibility shows no slow relaxation. UV irradiation switches the SMM response ON in I-UV; annealing switches it OFF again.

measurements.name: chiMT
measurements.conditions: low temperature below 30 K, 1 kOe, per Dy10

material_class.structural_family: oxalate-bridged pair of cyclic Dy5 phosphonate pentamers; methanol ligands replaced by water

synthesis.procedure: Crystals of I were converted to I-UV by UV irradiation at 365 nm for 3 days in air. The two coordinated methanol molecules are replaced by two water molecules. No numerical mass of I is given.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: UV irradiation of single crystals in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Single-crystal-to-single-crystal transformation; structure collected at 123(2) K.

properties.summary: I-UV is an SMM. Zero-field ac data fit Orbach, Raman and QTM processes, with a narrow relaxation-time distribution (alpha about 0.15).

material_class.structural_family: oxalate-bridged pair of cyclic Dy5 phosphonate pentamers after loss of two water molecules

synthesis.procedure: A single crystal of I was heated in situ under flowing nitrogen on the diffractometer at 100 °C for half an hour to give I-A-N2, whose data were collected at 373 K. Bulk I-A-Ar, used for magnetism, was obtained by annealing I-UV at 100 °C under argon in a glovebox for 2 days. No numerical sample mass is stated.
synthesis.time: 0.5 h under N2 on the diffractometer; 2 days under Ar in a glovebox
synthesis.vessel_or_method: in situ nitrogen flow on a Bruker D8 diffractometer, or argon glovebox annealing
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: SCSC transformation; I-A-Ar was loaded in a glovebox and immobilized in n-eicosane for magnetic measurements.

properties.summary: The annealed form (measured as I-A-Ar) loses slow relaxation and is a non-SMM, reversing the ON state of I-UV.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: rehydrated decanuclear dysprosium phosphonate after air exposure of the annealed crystal

material_class.structural_family: rehydrated oxalate-bridged Dy5-dimer; same molecular content as I-UV but a distinct SCSC state

synthesis.procedure: The same single crystal of I-A-N2 was exposed to air at 25 °C for one week to give I-A-N2-cool, and data were collected at 123 K. The paper states that the refinement was poor and the structure was not deposited. Air exposure of bulk I-A-Ar restores SMM behaviour and is treated as the corresponding rehydrated form. No numerical sample mass is given.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: standing in air after in situ annealing
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: SCSC rehydration; 11 lattice water sites were located, most disordered. Not deposited in the CCDC because of poor data (R1 11.1%, wR2 27.1%).

properties.summary: Standing the annealed non-SMM in air restores SMM behaviour with a slightly lower barrier than I-UV. The metrics are reported for air-exposed I-A-Ar, which the paper equates with the rehydrated structure.

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field, air-exposed I-A-Ar; also 26.1 cm^-1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: pair of crystallographically independent neutral cyclic Dy5 phosphonate pentamers chloroform solvate

material_class.structural_family: two discrete cyclic Dy5 phosphonate pentamers (molecules A and B) with two CHCl3

synthesis.procedure: H2EDDC (44.7 mg, 0.15 mmol) and Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (61.8 mg, 0.15 mmol) in methanol (20 mL) were stirred with triethylamine (0.14 mL, 1.0 mmol) at room temperature. After 12 h, C15H11PO3H2 (27.2 mg, 0.1 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred overnight. The yellow precipitate was filtered, dissolved in chloroform (5 mL), evaporated to 2 mL under vacuum, and transferred to a 5 mL glass tube. Red hexagonal crystals formed by slow diffusion of n-hexane (2 mL) over one week.
synthesis.time: 12 h, then overnight stirring, then one week diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow precipitate filtered, dissolved in chloroform, concentrated to 2 mL, and crystallized by diffusion of n-hexane (2 mL).

properties.summary: II shows zero-field SMM behaviour with a much higher effective barrier than I-UV. Dc data are reported per Dy10 for the crystal containing two pentamers.

measurements.name: chiMT
measurements.conditions: low temperature below 30 K, 1 kOe, per Dy10

source_locations.location: Table 1 and elemental analysis for II
